mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 7.5% for 3 consecutive months signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 7.5% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in residential construction (HOUST < 550k units) and rising consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.2% YoY) signals housing market contraction with inflationary pressure, reducing corporate profit margins and driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST declines and CPIAUCSL rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) during manufacturing slowdowns indicates supply chain disruptions that increase input costs and reduce corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5%) triggers Federal Reserve tightening expectations, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS > 134,000k persons) indicates labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate revenue, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth is positive, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer spending (RSAFS > 350,000 million dollars) during late-cycle expansion supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 350000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and rising unemployment (UNRATE > 7.5%) signals economic contraction with dual supply and labor market pressures, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
